settings.title: AI assistant
settings.description: Choose the AI that answers questions about your experiments, and give it your own key.
settings.keyHint: From your provider's website. It stays in this browser: it is sent with each question and never saved or logged by the app's server.
settings.addressHint: Ollama runs on your own computer and needs no key. Only an address on this computer (localhost) is accepted.
settings.modelHint: Pick a suggestion or type any model name your provider offers.
settings.privacy: What you ask, and the notes, values and references the assistant reads to answer, are sent to the provider you choose. With Ollama they stay on this computer.

errors.notReady: Enter a key and a model first (Ollama needs a model and a local address).
errors.localDisabled: Ollama is not available here: it only works when the app runs on your own computer.
errors.unauthorized: The provider refused the key. Check that it is correct and still active.
errors.modelNotFound: That model was not found. Check the model name.
errors.rateLimited: The provider says there are too many requests, or the account has no credit left. Try again later.
errors.unreachable: The provider could not be reached. Check your internet connection (or that Ollama is running).
errors.timeout: The provider took too long to answer. Try again.
errors.failed: The AI could not answer. Check the settings and try again.
errors.noCredit: The provider says the account has no credit left. Add credit on the provider's billing page, then try again.

chat.title: Assistant
chat.noProject: Open a project, or choose one above, to ask about it.
chat.emptyHint: It answers from your samples, notes and references. If it does not have something, it says so.
chat.example1: What changed between these samples and what stayed the same?
chat.example2: Which sample has the highest result, and what was different about it?
chat.example3: Which samples are missing a measurement?
chat.notReady: Add your AI key (or choose Ollama) in Settings to ask questions.
chat.privacy: Your question and the records it reads are sent to your AI provider.
chat.noRecords: This answer was written without reading your records, so it may not be based on your data. Check it before relying on it.

summarise.done: Summary saved. You can edit it.
summarise.needsSettings: Add your AI key in Settings first.
